open_questions: Length: built to the R-3896-1 envelope drawing (224.5 in, 5.70 m). The fact sheet says 19 ft (5.79 m), R-3896-1's text 19.2 ft, NASA's 2013 slides 18.4 ft.

Bell contour: no contour published. Built as a 30 to 15 degree bell from the throat (62.5 in below the gimbal) to the 10:1 plane; the manual puts the 3:1 plane "approximately 30 inches below the throat", where this bell is 1.68 m across against 1.53 m for 3:1. A bell that matches both would need a longer nozzle than the envelope allows.
Chamber and oxidizer dome diameters, and the gimbal block, are estimated: R-3896-1 gives no figures. The injector drawings in the R-3896-1A supplement may.
Pipe routing and the turbopump's position are estimated from the drawings and photos.
Finish: bare metal, as in the shop and museum photos; flight engines were wrapped in insulation (fact sheet).
Photo caption 6862832 says 12.5 ft at the exit: that matches R-3896-1's 147 in envelope over the rings (12.25 ft), not the 139 in lip.
No reference model: NASA 3D Resources has only a low-detail Saturn V with plain bells, and the Sketchfab F-1 (Defonten) can't be downloaded and has an editorial licence.

Turbine exhaust manifold: R-3896-1 Figure 2-22 gives 125 in between the torus's centres with a 13.5 in tube at the inlet, which would put its inside edge at 49 in radius, inside the 55 in nozzle at the 10:1 plane. Built hugging the nozzle instead (photo_6862832), so the inlet side reaches about 83 in out, past the drawing's 73.5 in envelope.

photo_6862832: about twenty bands from the exit to the throat region. Estimated.

karp_illustration: below the ribbed top the bands come in two layers. Bottom (in the illustration y 300-400 at 97.5 px/m: from the exhaust manifold up to about 0.94 m above the 10:1 plane, 42% of the nozzle's length): darker bluish bands set closer together, hardly any straps. Middle (y 125-300: up to about 1.8 m, 80%, where the ribs start): lighter bands with many short straps between neighbouring bands, two to four per gap. Each band is a wide flat strap with a row of slots along its middle: built as two strips with a narrow gap where the tube wall shows. Strap angles are placed at random (seeded) to match that look; band counts, sizes, gap and colours (spec materials cres and bright_steel) estimated.
